translations.web: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to Yahweh; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.
translations.bsb: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. So he prayed to the LORD, who spoke to him and gave him a sign.
translations.kjv: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
translations.asv: In those days Hezekiah was sick even unto death: and he prayed unto Jehovah; and he spake unto him, and gave him a sign.
